classic-day.en: Industrial light chrome; rectilinear controls and today's default brightness.
classic-day.zh-Hans: 工业风浅色界面；直角控件，沿用现有明亮默认。
classic-day.zh-Hant: 工業風淺色介面；直角控件，沿用現有明亮預設。

classic-night.en: Industrial dark chrome; rectilinear controls and today's default darkness.
classic-night.zh-Hans: 工业风深色界面；直角控件，沿用现有暗色默认。
classic-night.zh-Hant: 工業風深色介面；直角控件，沿用現有暗色預設。

fancy-day.en: Refined light chrome with teal accent, soft corners, and branded title mark.
fancy-day.zh-Hans: 精致浅色界面；青绿强调色、柔和圆角与品牌化标题。
fancy-day.zh-Hant: 精緻淺色介面；青綠強調色、柔和圓角與品牌化標題。

fancy-night.en: Refined dark chrome with teal accent, soft corners, and branded title mark.
fancy-night.zh-Hans: 精致深色界面；青绿强调色、柔和圆角与品牌化标题。
fancy-night.zh-Hant: 精緻深色介面；青綠強調色、柔和圓角與品牌化標題。
